content:
Here's what Tesla's revenue data shows from its most recent 10-K filing:

| Fiscal Year | Revenue |
|---|---|
| FY2025 (ended Dec 31, 2025) | $94.83 billion |
| FY2024 (ended Dec 31, 2024) | $97.69 billion |

**Calculation:**
> ($94.83B − $97.69B) ÷ $97.69B × 100 ≈ **−2.9%**

📉 Tesla's revenue **declined by approximately 2.9%** in its latest fiscal year (FY2025), falling from **$97.69 billion** to **$94.83 billion**.

This marks a notable reversal from Tesla's historically strong top-line growth. The data comes from Tesla's 10-K filed on **January 29, 2026**.

> ⚠️ *This is educational analysis only, not investment advice.*
